padding.request: DIAGNOSTIC REQUEST: Use object A once now. Reply only with the valid control command, without commentary.
padding.filler_sources: Repeated plain word versus deterministic descriptive sentences with no controls, digits, arithmetic or imperative tasks
padding.targets: Exact entire chat input lengths721/1600/3085 for both types; wrapper markers identical; empty-wrapper control isolates marker addition from short reference

One specimen stream per type, not a general padding-type sample

prediction.rule_card: RULE CARD: TOUCH A adds one to the number, except at the upper bound 8 where the number stays 8. TOUCH B changes the sign of the number.
prediction.request: PREDICTION REQUEST: If the host applies {action} once from the current number, what number will result? Reply with only the integer, without commentary.
prediction.execution: Save and hash prediction before host executes its declared action in an independent copy. Model text is never dispatched as an action. No outcome/feedback goes to subsequent model trials.
outcomes: Whether prediction followed supplied rule, without claiming discovery
limits: No-rule has no evidence identifying the hidden mapping; correct guesses do not establish discovery
Rule card changes both content and length; no pure causal card-benefit claim
Host executes the action, not a model-generated command
Supplied-rule use differs from inference, transfer, self-correction and autonomous choice

retention: All plans/prompts/IDs/outputs/effects/format failures; no truncation or selective retries
